label: Grammar, Usage, & Mechanics
raw_text: Learn and apply conventions of Standard English grammar, usage, and mechanics to aid the comprehension of texts and to communicate clearly in written and spoken language.
child_texts: Form regular plural nouns by adding -s or -es. (Master)
Form and use verbs by adding -ing, -ed, or -s. (Master)
Form and use the simple verb tenses. (Continue)
Use determiners (articles, possessive determiners, demonstrative adjectives). (Continue)
Use periods, exclamation marks, and question marks at the end of sentences. (Continue)
Form plural nouns by changing -y to -ies. (Introduce)
Use personal pronouns (subject, object, and possessive). (Introduce)
Use commas to separate items in a series and to format dates, addresses, salutations, and closings. (Introduce)
Use apostrophes to form contractions and singular possessive nouns. (Introduce)
Form and use irregular plural nouns. (Introduce)
Form and use the past tense of irregular verbs. (Introduce)
Use coordinating conjunctions to join words, phrases, or clauses. (Introduce)
